info.name: Smart Warehouse - warehouse_seed.sql
info.description: SIMULATED seed data. Set password and baseUrl, then run folders 01-04 once in order. Maps SQL warehouses to existing Kho 1/Kho 2. Products and shelves are created in the application; rerunning creation folders can produce duplicate errors. Folder 05 tests forecasting separately. SQL inventory/RFID/transactions have no current ingestion endpoints; full source data is in warehouse_seed.data.json.

item.name: 01 Login - set password in collection variables

request.description: Uses existing monitored warehouses because POST /api/shelves rejects warehouses without monitoringSlot. Source warehouse names/codes remain in warehouse_seed.data.json.
